zh-CN: 提前准备 Codex 辅助功能控件，减少第一次按命令键时的初始化等待。
批准、拒绝和发送改用当前界面的对应按钮，无需为这些功能修改快捷键或重新打开 Codex。
授权变化后自动重建按键监听；系统权限仍未生效时，在安全恢复键盘后自动重开 NuPhy Lab 一次。
保留 F1–F12 默认分配和 Air75 V3 连接动画。此包用于首次安装体验测试。
en: Prepare Codex accessibility controls ahead of the first command-key press to reduce initialization delays.
Approve, decline and send now use the corresponding visible controls without editing keybindings or restarting Codex.
Recreate key capture after permission changes. If macOS retains stale permission state, safely restore the keyboard and relaunch NuPhy Lab once.
Preserve the F1–F12 defaults and Air75 V3 connection animation. This build is for first-install testing.
